memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, moderate severity.
Patient reports persistent low mood, loss of interest in usual activities, fatigue, early‑morning insomnia, and decreased appetite over the past 8 weeks. He denies suicidal thoughts. Appearance is tidy, psychomotor activity normal, affect congruent and restricted. PHQ‑9 score from today’s labs is 14. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Sertraline 50 mg oral tablet once daily. Start today, review in 4 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, partial response.
Symptoms: mood improved, energy better, but still reports mild anhedonia and occasional early waking. Sleep improved to 5‑6 hours, appetite near normal. No psychomotor agitation. PHQ‑9 now 9. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Escitalopram 10 mg oral tablet once daily. Add to current sertraline 50 mg OD. Review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling better overall, sleeping through the night most days, but I notice a bit of dry mouth and occasional dizziness when I stand up quickly. The medication seems to help my mood, though I still have some low‑energy afternoons.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, improving with emerging side‑effects.
Patient describes better mood and sleep, but reports dry mouth and occasional orthostatic dizziness. Examination: vitals BP 128/72 sitting, 118/68 standing; no postural hypotension >20 mmHg. Dry mucosa noted. PHQ‑9 6. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stop sertraline 50 mg OD.
Start mirtazapine 15 mg oral tablet at bedtime.
Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, well controlled.
Patient reports mood stable, good sleep, energy adequate. No side‑effects now. Examination: calm, affect appropriate. PHQ‑9 5 indicates mild residual symptoms. Vitamin B12 low on labs. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12) 500 mcg oral tablet once daily. Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD and mirtazapine 15 mg HS.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up pulmonology review for 2026-09-01 at 10:30 AM. Patient confirmed via clinic app.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, stable on current regimen.
Patient denies new depressive symptoms, reports good energy and sleep. No medication adverse effects noted. Examination: relaxed, affect full. PHQ‑9 4. Smoking status: never smoked; pack‑years 0. Plan: consider tapering mirtazapine after 3 months if mood remains stable.
